import subprocess
commands = [
    ["swift", "build", "--package-path", "Packages/CatanEngine", "-Xswiftc", "-warnings-as-errors"],
    ["swift", "build", "--package-path", "Packages/CatanAI", "-Xswiftc", "-warnings-as-errors"],
    ["swift", "test", "--package-path", "Packages/CatanEngine", "--enable-code-coverage"],
    ["swift", "test", "--package-path", "Packages/CatanAI", "--enable-code-coverage"],
    ["./scripts/coverage.sh", "Packages/CatanEngine", "95", "--reuse"],
    ["./scripts/coverage.sh", "Packages/CatanAI", "95", "--reuse"],
]
failed = False
for command in commands:
    print("RUN:", " ".join(command), flush=True)
    result = subprocess.run(command, check=False)
    print("EXIT:", result.returncode, " ".join(command), flush=True)
    failed = failed or result.returncode != 0
raise SystemExit(1 if failed else 0)
